name: Rent roll
what: A list of every lease at a property on one date, with the tenant, space and rent terms.

fields.label: As of
fields.definition: The date the rent roll describes.

fields.label: Rentable area
fields.definition: Square feet the rent is charged on.

fields.label: Lease start
fields.definition: The commencement date of the current term.

fields.label: Lease end
fields.definition: The expiration date of the current term.

fields.label: Base rent per square foot per year
fields.definition: Annual base rent divided by rentable area.

fields.label: Expense recoveries
fields.definition: How operating expenses are passed through: gross, modified gross or triple net.

fields.label: Options
fields.definition: Renewal, expansion, termination or purchase options.

fields.label: Status
fields.definition: Occupied, vacant, or occupied but not paying.
